name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partnerships Account Executive | B2B SaaS Sales, Channel Development & Full-Cycle Closing
summary: B2B SaaS sales professional with 15+ years running full-cycle sales and partner-channel development for technology platforms. Built and managed reseller/partner networks, closed complex CRM and software deals with C-suite and non-technical buyers alike, and consistently ranked among top performers against aggressive quotas. Comfortable owning a book of business end to end, from prospecting through close and ongoing partner enablement.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running consultative discovery to identify needs and scope the right solution.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand engagement scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with business objectives.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured technical requirements, acting as the bridge between business intent and complex product output.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated marketing strategy as strategic lead, coordinating execution and proposals across internal departments and client stakeholders.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation-management solutions among technical and non-technical buyers alike.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority partner feedback into roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure (all but the final few months), holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Closed deals of $20K and larger later in tenure, mixed with a base of smaller wins.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
